lines.text: At Ephesus Paul reasons with the Jews, declines to stay longer, and promises to return if God is willing.
Paul lands at Caesarea, greets the church at Damascus, goes to Antioch, then strengthens disciples in Galatia and Phrygia.
Apollos of Alexandria speaks boldly in the synagogue, knowing only the baptism of Peter, so Priscilla and Aquila teach him.
The brothers write to the disciples in Achaia to welcome Apollos, who proves from the Scriptures that Jesus is Christ.
